question: Where’s the closest café on the path going northwest from the University of Tennessee Health Science Center, Memphis, TN?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%University of Tennessee Health Science Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Memphis%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TN%' LIMIT 1), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5 -- Northwest direction (292.5 to 337.5 degrees) ORDER BY ST_Distance( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%University of Tennessee Health Science Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Memphis%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TN%' LIMIT 1)::geography, p.geometry::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
